column1: Which file owns the top-level object that runs a full build from start to finish and fires the lifecycle hooks plugins tap into?
Where does webpack keep track of which modules belong to which chunks, and vice versa?
Where is the logic that decides how modules get grouped into separate shared bundles based on size limits and cache group rules?
Where does webpack implement scope hoisting, merging multiple ES modules into a single function scope in the output?
Where does the code that treats CSS files as a first-class module type, generating and rendering their output chunks, live?
Where does webpack decode a compiled WebAssembly binary to extract its imports and exports as dependencies?
Where does webpack handle downloading and caching modules that are imported directly from an http or https URL?
Where does webpack generate the universal wrapper that lets a bundle work as an AMD module, a CommonJS module, or a global variable depending on the environment?
Where does webpack assign short, reproducible numeric ids to chunks based on a hash of their content instead of using their full names?
Where is the Set implementation that defers merging in additional iterables until the collection is actually iterated or checked?
Where does webpack wrap its hashing implementations so many small updates get batched together instead of hashing data one small chunk at a time?
Where does webpack's persistent cache serializer write and read its data to disk, using gzip or brotli compression on large payloads?
Which file implements the strategy for persisting the whole compilation cache to disk as one combined bundle of serialized data between builds?
Where does webpack translate a target string like node or web into the set of platform properties, such as having require or a DOM, used elsewhere in the compiler?
Where does webpack hook into a filesystem watcher library to detect file changes when running in watch mode under Node.js?
Where does the runtime code that loads additional chunks via a script tag and a global callback array actually get generated?
Where does webpack configure chunk loading to use importScripts for the web worker build target?
Where does webpack mark Electron's built-in main-process and renderer-process modules as external instead of bundling them?
Where does webpack implement building a module only once it is actually requested at runtime, deferring compilation of everything else?
Where is the runtime helper that computes the on-disk filename for a chunk being loaded, based on its id and content hash, generated?
Where does webpack turn JavaScript source into an AST using acorn and walk it to discover require and import calls and other dependencies?
Where does webpack build the nested plain-object representation of assets, chunks, and modules that later gets rendered into the stats output?
